reviewer_requested_model: gpt-6-luna/high per project AGENTS.md; runtime model identity is not independently attested by this artifact
scope: Independent static/data-sample review only. No training, no test reads, no shared-state edits, no ROOT_GO issuance.

review.future_input: PASS: runner constructs features from origin_cycle, current SOH, and past20 rate; it asserts visible_through_cycle == origin_cycle, origin < event_cycle, and both required rate windows are present. Sampled first/last data_rows of one train and one val feature CSV obey the cutoff.
review.roles_and_isolation: PASS within the disclosed source-index cohort: 26 train and 9 val cells, disjoint cell IDs asserted by runner; test cohort indices [11,20,23,27,42,43] and continuation aliases [7,8,9,15,16] are explicitly excluded by asset protocol. Source index is not a globally verified physical serial.
review.cycle_and_event_semantics: PASS for scoped development question: origins are actual source cycles 100 through first observed QDischarge <= 0.88 Ah minus one; endpoint is first such observed cycle. Two raw cycle 100 checks map actual cycle 100 to raw index 99 with exact Qd equality. All selected cells are event-observed; no censoring claim.
review.weights_and_fits: PASS: each cell contributes equal total training weight, normalized to mean one and reused across all arms. Main thread corrected HistGradientBoostingRegressor import to sklearn.ensemble before fit and reports import validation; exactly three predeclared arms; HGB uses max_iter=150 and early_stopping=False; one thread is set for OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL; no optimizer steps. Fit-start is consumed and failures stop without retry. 180-second checks occur at fit boundaries, so the wall-time guard is not a hard interrupt during an individual estimator call.
review.evaluation_fairness: PASS for adaptive development comparison: A vs B uses matched age/SOH/rate20 inputs, B vs C adds only rate100; all use same train weights and seed. Primary comparison is within-cell median-RUL absolute error across available duration, then cell-equal mean; paired cell bootstrap and predeclared severe-overprediction/coverage guards are recorded.
review.known_exposure_and_identity: Explicitly bounded: the same nine development cells were previously exposed, so this is not independent confirmation. Manifest full_source_sha256 is UNKNOWN_NOT_FULL_FILE; barcode is opaque and physical serial identity is unverified. No independent-generalization or source-complete claim is supported.

decision_boundary: This review supports only a separate main-thread decision to issue GO_THREE_CPU_FITS_ONLY for the hash-bound runner/protocol/manifest. It does not issue ROOT_GO, change global new_fits_allowed, authorize test access, or support independent/generalization claims.
